best_plan.name: p6
best_plan.rationale: p6 achieved the strongest and most consistent ranking quality among the tested plans, with two runs at 0.459659 and 0.463069 spearman correlation. While p2 had one slightly lower-cost run and one high-quality run, its quality varied much more and dropped substantially on rerun. p6 uses a better scoring prompt with the same simple physical structure, giving the best quality for only a modest increase in cost and latency over p2.

plan_codes.p1:
pipeline = PhysicalPipeline(plan_name, "Reviews.csv", load_data("Reviews.csv"))
pipeline.filter(lambda row: isinstance(row["reviewText"], str) and row["reviewText"].strip() != "")
pipeline.sem_map(
    [{"name": "review_score", "type": int, "description": "Score this movie review's opinion of the movie on a 1 to 5 scale, where 1 is very negative, 2 is negative, 3 is mixed or neutral, 4 is positive, and 5 is very positive. Return an integer from 1 to 5."}],
    model=pz.Model.GOOGLE_GEMINI_2_5_FLASH_LITE,
    depends_on=["reviewText"]
)
pipeline.groupby(group_by_fields=["idx"], agg_funcs=["average"], agg_fields=["review_score"])
pipeline.project(["idx", "average(review_score)"])
pipeline
